symptom: Inconsistent error response schema across API endpoints during code review.

error.message: Team name is required and cannot be empty

agent_generated_schema.error: Invalid team data: name is required and must be between 1 and 100 characters

client_impact: Frontend clients and SDKs consuming the API expect a structured error object. Accessing res.error.code throws undefined / runtime crashes or requires special-casing per route, degrading API ergonomics.
root_cause_context_failure: The context package described the error schema in prose (in progress/context-package.md) but failed to provide: (1) a shared helper function (e.g. sendError(res, status, code, message)), and (2) an existing reference route showing the exact invocation pattern. The AI defaulted to standard inline serialization.
